items.title: Whitespace guard on submit
steps: Type only spaces in comment box
items.expected: Blank/whitespace does not create a comment or reply.
items.evidence: 2026-07-28: Human verified via -d finalize (user skipped -tw). submitComment trims and returns false on empty body.

items.title: Enter submits comment and reply
steps: Type a comment and press Enter — comment appears
Click Reply, type a reply, press Enter — reply appears under parent
In either box, press Shift+Enter — newline inserted, no submit
Confirm Comment/Reply buttons still submit when clicked
items.expected: Enter submits; Shift+Enter newlines; buttons remain.
items.evidence: 2026-07-28: Human verified via -d finalize (user skipped -tw). submitOnEnter on both textareas; buttons unchanged.
